description: This Java source file defines an exception class 'FeatureNotAccessibleException', which indicates that a requested feature does not exist or access is insufficient. It is part of the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.things.exceptions package and extends DittoRuntimeException. The class provides static methods for creating instances from messages or JSON objects, and contains a nested Builder class for fluent construction.
